sourceRefs.locator: Lod, Lydda, Diospolis 1, p. 4 (site, Israel Grid 19125/65282), pp. 8–10 with figs. 3–4 and table 1 (1552 shares and 1596/97 survey), pp. 11–12 (December 1606, Jerusalem sijill 84:27).
Zeitschrift des Deutschen Palästina-Vereins 139.2, pp. 258–289. Author manuscript §§1–2, 195 names in the endowment deed, entries for al-Ludd and Bayt Iksā and its field.

note.de: Die Urkunde von 1552 nennt Dörfer, Fluren und Anteile der Stiftung bei Lydda. In Jindās bestanden die Ansprüche mehrerer Stiftungen nebeneinander.
note.en: The 1552 deed lists villages, tracts of farmland and shares in the district of Lydda. Several endowments had claims on income from Jindās.
